Diventa parte del nostro team e modella il futuro della cura. Stai cercando una nuova sfida nel campo acuto o vorresti andare in direzione di IPS o di emergenza? Tu fai questo Cura e cura professionale dei pazienti

Condividere la responsabilità di una qualità basata su prove di cura e partecipazione al processo di miglioramento continuo

Promozione della cooperazione mirata e orientata alla soluzione all'interno del team di supporto interprofessionale

Garantire competenze future attraverso l'accompagnamento motivato e il supporto dei nostri tirocinanti

A2)

Condizioni di lavoro interessanti: Ore lavorative flessibili. Che si tratti di condivisione di lavoro, giorni fissi o preferenze di servizio. Siamo aperti e pronti a fare il maggior numero possibile di desideri. Sostegno alla progressione in tedesco o francese, politica del personale familiare con l'asilo, buona accessibilità con i trasporti pubblici e auto (parcheggio gratuito). Prospettive di carriera: Supporto per ulteriori opportunità di formazione e sviluppo individuale. Squadra forte: Una cultura aziendale apprezzata e un team motivato che si unisce. Tempo di introduzione: Alleghiamo grande importanza per l'arrivo e l'integrazione nel centro ospedaliero, così come nella squadra stessa. Qualità della vita: lavorare a Biel, la città bilingue tra il lago e le montagne, con alto valore di svago.

Per ulteriori informazioni, Stefanie Peter-Aeberhard o Florian Baumann, Team Leader, è a vostra disposizione su Tel. 032 324 33 50. Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione online!

Graduated nurse / -mann acute care (80-100%) - Hospital Center Biel / Centre hospitalier Bee Working on the pulse of life: The Biel Hospital Center is one of the leading hospitals in the region, known for its innovative strength and proximity to patients. Become part of our team and shape the future of care. Are you looking for a new challenge in the acute field or would like to go in the direction of IPS or emergency? Then you are exactly right with Steffi and Florian on the C 4/5! The C4/5 is ideal for newly graduated nurses who are looking for a super base after their studies, where you can learn a lot and develop super further, e.g. in the future towards IPS or emergency. In order to strengthen their team, Steffi and Florian are looking for an acute care specialist (80-100%) for their acute care bed station with 28-30 beds. You do this Professional care and care of patients

Share responsibility for an evidence-based quality of care and participation in the continuous improvement process

Promotion of goal- and solution-oriented cooperation within the interprofessional support team

Ensuring future expertise through motivated accompaniment and support of our trainees

Diploma as a nursing specialist HF/FH (degree 2026 also possible) Professional experience in the field of acute medicine or the desire to be able to work independently, a pronounced sense of responsibility as well as high quality standards on your own work Organized and conscientious working method Variety in everyday life gives you pleasure, challenges you see as a positive challenge team ability, flexibility, resilience Communication in German or French (word and writing) with knowledge of the other language (min. A2)

Attractive working conditions: Flexible working hours. Whether job sharing, fixed days or service preferences. We are open and ready to make as many wishes as possible. Support in the progression in German or French, family-friendly personnel policy with day-care, good accessibility by public transport and car (free parking). Career prospects: Support for further education and individual development opportunities. Strong team: An appreciative corporate culture and a motivated team that pulls together. Introduction time: We attach great importance to the arrival and integration in the hospital center as well as in the team itself. Quality of life: Working in Biel, the bilingual city between the lake and mountains, with high leisure value.

For further information, Stefanie Peter-Aeberhard or Florian Baumann, Team Leader, is at your disposal on Tel. 032 324 33 50. We look forward to your online application!

Neuropsychologe/in 60% - Spitalzentrum Biel / Centre hospitalier Bienne Das Spitalzentrum Biel ist das öffentliche Zentrumsspital der zweisprachigen Region Biel-Seeland-Berner Jura. Bist du interessiert, an der Seite unserer 2'300 Mitarbeitenden für die Gesundheit unserer Bevölkerung tätig zu sein? Die Abteilung Neuropsychologie führt eigenständig und interprofessionell Abklärungen von Erkrankungen aus dem gesamten neurologischen und einem Teil des entwicklungsneurologischen Spektrums durch. Eine Memory Clinic ist ebenfalls in die Neurologie integriert. Wir suchen ab 01.01.2027 oder nach Vereinbarung für einen unbefristeten Zeitraum eine/n: Neuropsychologe/in 60% Das tust du Du führst selbständig neuropsychologische Abklärungen bei ambulanten Patientinnen und Patienten durch (Tätigkeit nach Vereinbarung, Möglichkeit Kinder, Erwachsene und ältere Menschen zu sehen, zu entwicklungsneurologischen, neurodegenerativen, neurologischen oder psychiatrischen Themen) und gelegentlich auch bei stationären Patientinnen und Patienten.

Du berätst unsere Patientinnen und Patienten sowie deren Angehörige

Du nimmst aktiv an interdisziplinären Diskussionen teil.

Master in Psychologie mit Spezialisierung in Neuropsychologie (oder gleichwertiger Abschluss) Fachtitel in Neuropsychologie FSP/EAN (oder gleichwertige Ausbildung) abgeschlossen oder in Weiterbildung Erfahrung in der neuropsychologischen Beurteilung und im Verfassen von Beurteilungsberichten sowie die Fähigkeit, diese Tätigkeiten selbstständig auszuführen Persönlichkeit mit Motivation und Initiative Sehr gute Deutsch- oder Französischkenntnisse; gute Kenntnisse der jeweils anderen Sprache sind von Vorteil

Eine abwechslungsreiche und interessante Tätigkeit mit einem breiten Spektrum an Problemstellungen Integration in ein Team von Neuropsychologinnen und in ein interdisziplinäres Team von zweisprachigen Kolleginnen in einem dynamischen Umfeld Vielfältige berufliche Perspektiven mit der Möglichkeit zur individuellen Weiterbildung und Perfektionierung. Sichere und fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen Sehr zentralgelegener und moderner Arbeitsort

Für weitere Auskünfte steht dir Frau Roxane Etienne, Leiterin Neuropsychologie, Tel. 032 324 44 02 gerne zur Verfügung. Wir freuen uns auf Deine online-Bewerbung.
